rechit.description: Per-cell mean and std over training set. Preprocessing: clip to [0, +inf) (no upper bound), log(x + 1e-3), then (x - mean) / std.

hlf.description: Per-feature mean and std over training set. Preprocessing: (x - mean) / std, then nan/inf -> 0.

pf.description: Per-feature mean and std over training set for the RAW feature vector (13 features, before one-hot encoding of pf_ID). Only the indices in standardize_idx are normalised; index 4 (raw pf_ID) is replaced by a 6-class one-hot vector; index 5 (fromPV) is kept as-is (integer in {0,1,2,3}).

es.description: Preshower strips: reducedEgamma:reducedESRecHits in the photon's endcap; dx, dy = strip centre minus the primary-vertex -> SC-seed line at the strip z (cm); kept if |dx|,|dy| <= window_half_width_cm or the strip is in the SC preshower clusters. Features: dx/20, dy/20, (sign(E) log1p(|E|/1e-3 GeV) - energy_mean)/energy_std, plane==1, plane==2, linked.

model.description: sparse_cell_es_frame_dr_transformer (cells + PF + preshower strips, shared Delta eta/phi frame)
model.inputs: img(B,1,32,32) aux(B,18) pf_x(B,L,18) pf_mask(B,L) es_x(B,S,6) es_mask(B,S) geom(B,3)
model.pf_conventions: associated packed PF candidates removed; dR <= pf.dr_cone; photons without PF candidates get ONE all-zero row with mask True (training convention)
model.geom_conventions: geom = (photon eta, photon phi, |SC eta| < 1.479); phi = 0 for photons without a real PF candidate (training recovered phi from the first PF candidate)
model.verification_dataset: 4,000 photons of the 2024 gamma + jets validation sample
model.training: 2024 gamma + jets simulation (GJet, DoubleEMEnriched): prompt photons (signal) vs. non-prompt photons and misidentified jets (background); 40 epochs
